text: NCERT source: https://ncert.nic.in/pdf/focus-group/NCF-FS_2022EN.pdf section 6.2.1 printed pp. 177–178. It describes planned observation, recording concrete evidence, and reflection to inform teaching. Saksham’s slate-response activity is an adaptation, not a direct NCERT prescription. Exact quote matching and valid resource IDs are machine-checkable. Relevance, unsupported inference and instructional suitability require additional model checks, evaluation and human judgement. Do not rank teachers or infer capability, motivation or child diagnoses. Capture mentor notes without child-identifying data.

text: Architecture proposal. The local prototype currently uses React/Next.js, browser-local storage, Zod schemas, exact evidence-substring verification and curated resource summaries. A server-side Anthropic Messages route exists, but successful live-provider operation was not established in this session. Retrieval and PostgreSQL/pgvector are planned. NCF reference: https://ncert.nic.in/pdf/focus-group/NCF-FS_2022EN.pdf. Before indexing any material, verify licence/permission, version, section and language. Exclude identifying child information and establish consent, retention and access controls before any pilot. No child audio corpus or fine-tuning is needed for this MVP. No automatic teacher ranking. Live AI requires connectivity; a model failure must preserve notes and return a recoverable error.

text: Evaluation plan only. Forty fictional/de-identified expert-reviewed scenarios should cover sparse evidence, contradictory notes, negation, Hindi/code-switching and attempts to elicit punitive judgements. Separate development cases from a held-out set. Define supported claims and use two expert reviewers for disagreements. Compare with an ungrounded LLM baseline. The proposed field sample is small and for usability/formative learning, not causal evidence of student impact. Time target measures the reviewed plan, not the classroom observation or teacher conversation. Proposed milestone dates follow the supplied hackathon guidelines. Current status: demo capture, evidence view, scripted rehearsal, commitments and reload persistence tested. Live Claude, expert endorsement, full Hindi localisation, secure multi-user deployment and offline reload resilience still require validation.
